# Air Products and Chemicals Deep Dive Analysis

Report 146 | Published 2024-09-29 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-9-29/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/146.json)

Liquidity, bitcoin, and industrial-gas valuation.

Bitcoin direction succeeded at both twelve and eighteen months, with a substantial intervening gain reversal. The APD analysis underweighted concentrated project and capital-allocation risk despite durable legacy operations. Brazil current-account support was factually reversed. Long-horizon China, APD and gold-relative calls remain open.

**Coverage:** Read all blocks, including recovered company-profile block 155. Covers macro, China, digital assets, APD and gold. Incidental company facts and portfolio sizes excluded. Quoted 2020 gold/bitcoin allocation is a historical repeat, not a fresh call.

### 146-C03

**Brazil runs current-account surplus.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | empirical |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | brazil-external-balance |
| Source blocks | 17 |
| Thesis family | brazil-external-balance |

The contemporaneous central-bank report explicitly shows a current-account deficit. A merchandise trade surplus is not equivalent because services and income flows also count. This materially weakens the stated currency-support premise.

**Direction:** Contradicted for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [September inflation report](https://www.bcb.gov.br/content/about/presentationstexts/RI_2024_3Q_EN.pdf) | Banco Central do Brasil | 2024-09-26 | Verified in the audit

Pages 21-22 describe an increased current-account deficit, not surplus, and forecast deficits of 2.3% GDP in 2024 and 2.7% in 2025.
